Change has been successfully rebased and submitted as f05f354d10f4a3ee30abcc8048b36c9a41fbf77b
Can we use `enum class` instead of `enum`?
Please specify `noexcept` if this API doesn't throw any exceptions, or mention `@throw` if it does throw.
Can be simplified as `l_systemMode = *l_isFieldModeEnabled ? types::SystemMode::FieldMode : types::SystemMode::LabMode;`

can you make this function more like 
bool isFieldModeEnabled() const noexcept;
you can still optimise this code, by not having a local variable [types::SystemMode l_systemMode] created

Do you have any idea when this property gets populated an by whom it is done?
Further I was thinking a bit differently to get the mode which is not via the busctl command

fieldmode is an u-boot environment variable which we can get by executing the command /sbin/fw_printenv..
Reference:
https://github.com/openbmc/phosphor-bmc-code-mgmt/blob/449e793c823154561a44b7827592ce73d877c834/bmc/item_updater.cpp#L710
we are not calling any dbus API here, should we avoid this inclusion ?
should we check size of l_cmdOutput, before accessing [0] index, is case if we receive empty vector?
